title: Arrives in Vietnam
description: Larry's Vietnam service began around September 1964. His port of entry and initial assignment have not yet been established from records.
researchNotes: His DD-214 credits 1 year, 1 month, 18 days of foreign service ending with separation on November 30, 1965. If that overseas service was continuous (Vietnam, then the Japan assignment), it began about October 12, 1964 — a few weeks later than the remembered September. The recollection stands as given; the NPRC file or travel records should settle the exact arrival date.
